scientific_integrity: Analytic argument with explicit determinant and positive Bernstein polynomial, accompanied by independent exact-rational moment expansions; finite checks not used as infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Only standardized centered jointly Gaussian triples; negative exponent u strictly between zero and one; positive exponents exactly four and two. Equality occurs at a singular covariance; the positive-definite version has a sharp unattained infimum. Priority outside the inspected published literature and independent validation remain open.
title: Sharp lower bound for a quartic–quadratic mixed-sign Gaussian moment
